content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Deviation — Section 2.1 (p0012).** The clause binds us to USD 2,000,000 of Services per year for three years on a take-or-pay basis "without reduction or termination rights" — squarely the walk-away position under MINCOMMIT, and well short of the fallback (single 12-month commitment, reducible on 30 days' notice, trued up rather than penalized). It also sits inconsistently with Section 9.4 (our convenience termination and refund of prepaid Fees), Section 7.1 (no minimum-use charge not identified in an Order Form) and Section 12.3 (Vendor's acknowledgement that we have made no minimum-volume commitment).

Redline (validated, preferred position): replace the commitment with "Customer has no minimum purchase, take-or-pay, or volume commitment… Fees only for Services ordered under an Order Form and actually provided, and no shortfall or unused-commitment charge applies," with the 12-month reducible/true-up structure offered as the negotiating fallback.
